title: finding(plugin-charts): the radar mark hard-codes `fillOpacity={0.6}` and never consults the series — authored `opacity` / `dashArray` AND the whole `variant: 'comparison'` treatment are dropped on a radar chart
body:
## Measured (objectui `origin/main` @ `c14d3a090`)

`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` resolves per-series presentation in one helper — `comparisonStyle` on `main` (`:92`), renamed `seriesStyle` by the objectui#7698 branch. Every cartesian mark calls it. The **radar** arm does not.

The radar branch (`:1719`) maps over `series` exactly like the cartesian arms do, and then renders:

```tsx
<Radar
  key={s.dataKey}
  dataKey={s.dataKey}
  stroke={color}
  fill={color}
  fillOpacity={0.6}
  {...animProps}
/>
```

`fillOpacity={0.6}` is a literal (`:1739`). The helper is never called on this path, and no other read of `s.opacity` / `s.dashArray` / `s.variant` exists in the branch. Control: `grep -rniE 'opacity|dasharray' packages/plugin-charts/src` (tests excluded) finds the helper, the cartesian `cmp?.…` call sites and the two `normalizeSeries` reads — and this literal, which the objectui#7698 card's own census classified as "a literal constant", i.e. deliberately outside that card's measured surface.

## Consequence

On `chartType: 'radar'`, three declared things are inert at once:

- `series[].opacity` — declared by `@objectstack/spec` as `ChartSeries.opacity` and by `@object-ui/types`' `ChartDataSeriesSchema`. Read by `normalizeSeries`, then discarded.
- `series[].dashArray` — same, and recharts' `Radar` is a **stroked** mark (`stroke={color}` right above), so unlike a bar or scatter this is a family where a dash would actually paint.
- `variant: 'comparison'` — a radar overlay gets none of the muted treatment every other family gets. The `variant` key is declared and documented with no family restriction.

So a radar series carrying any of the three draws identically to one carrying none.

## Relationship to objectui#7698

Adjacent, not the same card, and deliberately left out of it. objectui#7698 is about the `variant` gate and the Bar / Scatter marks inside the helper's own call graph; the radar arm never enters that graph, and its census counted this literal as out of scope. Repairing it is also not the same edit: passing the helper's result here would newly **mute** existing comparison radar series (the helper's non-bar / non-area fill default is `0.5`, against today's fixed `0.6`), which is a visible change to already-drawn charts and wants its own decision. That is exactly why it is filed rather than folded in.

Out of scope for objectui#7698, and still open after it. This card stands on its own.

Same measurement family, all separate: objectui#7690, objectui#7694, objectui#7682, objectui#7546.

Found while implementing objectui#7698 by the Claude Code dev seat, session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`; filed without an assignee for triage.
